item.title: Urgent Safety Concern – Large Tree at Council Property, 310 Dunkery Road, 27th September
item.description:
310 Dunkery Road is a Council property, and the tree is located within the garden of this Council-owned property. The tree has grown considerably large, and due to its size and proximity to our property, we are concerned that it could pose a significant risk to our house and the people on our property if it were to fall, or if large branches were to break, particularly during strong winds or severe weather. Our property is currently undergoing a loft extension, and construction workers are currently working on and around the roof of our house. This makes the potential risk particularly serious. If the tree or a large branch were to suddenly fall towards our property, it could cause severe structural damage to our house and could potentially put the lives and safety of the workers at risk.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dunkery Road, Mottingham, Greater London
